chunks: It has been sent down by the Lord of all the worlds.

key_terms.الْعَالَمِينَ: The worlds or all of creation

ai.seo_question: Who is the source of the Quranic revelation according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah as the Creator and Sustainer of all realms, reinforcing the concept of *Tawhid* not merely as monotheism but as comprehensive divine lordship. It establishes the Quran's authority as derived directly from the *Rabb al-'Alamin*, distinguishing it from human composition and affirming its role as a guide for both the spiritual and material worlds.
